title: Marquise Wheat Cuff
descriptionHtml:
Two rows of light, leaning into each other. An open gold cuff whose front is set with two rows of marquise-cut clear stones, each in its own fine claws and angled like the two sides of a wheat ear. The back is a slim plain band finished with small polished balls, so it slips on at the narrowest part of the wrist.

STYLING TIP: Let it be the only bracelet, with a bare neckline and hair pulled back.

Details

  • Style: Open cuff
  • Stones: Two slanted rows of clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm each
  • Width: Approximately 14mm across the stone rows
  • Setting: Fine claw settings, laid like the grains of a wheat ear
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
